Most people notice their skin losing firmness, joints feeling stiff, hair thinning and nails breaking and treat each problem separately without realizing they all share the same root cause. Collagen is the most abundant protein in the human body. It forms the structural foundation of your skin, hair, nails, joints and connective tissue. Think of it like the roots of a tree.  You cannot see them but everything above ground depends on them being strong. When collagen levels decline everything connected to it weakens at the same time. After your mid-20s your body produces less collagen every single year. Modern diets have also eliminated the food sources that naturally replenished it.  Bone broth, organ meats and connective tissue were staples of traditional cooking. Most people today eat muscle meat exclusively which contains almost no collagen. Hydrolyzed collagen biopeptides are broken down into smaller chains your body can actually absorb and use at the cellular level. Standard collagen molecules are too large for efficient absorption.  The hydrolyzed form makes a meaningful difference in bioavailability. Consistent daily supplementation over 8 to 12 weeks is what research supports for visible improvements in skin elasticity, joint comfort, hair strength and nail health. One scoop daily mixed into water, coffee or juice.  Simple and consistent.
